name: Echoing Crystal Cavern Choir
description: A cavern where stalactites are perfect crystal bells, resonating with a harmonic chord when wind passes.
prompt: Vast underground cavern filled with thousands of crystal stalactites shaped like bells of varying sizes. A gentle subterranean wind flows through, causing them to chime in a rich, layered harmony. Light from an unseen source refracts through the crystals, painting the walls in rainbow hues. Photorealistic, acoustic atmosphere implied, high resolution.
caption: Listen to the earth sing 🎶💎 #CrystalChoir
